fields.interpretation: The trained-child tick-zero servo offset is present in Torch and Dawn. Deployment graph quantization is the sealed CHCNS4 u16 half-bit graph decoded to float32 by both paths; learned readout and motor parameters remain float32. The small motor difference is amplified from sub-1.5e-8 MN-rate differences by the trained centered decoder. This is numerical parity evidence and does not establish physical competence.
